subject.title: fix(skills): forward owner handle to bulk security-verdict fetch for ambiguous slugs

question: Should OpenClaw wait for ClawHub to define and ship an owner-aware bulk verdict API, or use the existing single-skill verification endpoint as the owner-qualified ambiguity fallback?
rationale: The current hosted bulk contract does not accept the proposed field, while a fallback changes request volume, failure semantics, and the security-badge source of truth; that API behavior cannot safely be selected from this PR alone.

options.title: Define the bulk API first
options.body: Have ClawHub add and document an owner-qualified bulk-item contract, then prove this OpenClaw client against a live ambiguous-slug response.

options.title: Use a narrow verify fallback
options.body: Keep bulk items to `{ slug, version }` and use the documented owner-qualified single-skill verify endpoint only after an ambiguity/not-found result with a known owner.

recommendation.title: Define the bulk API first
recommendation.body: Have ClawHub add and document an owner-qualified bulk-item contract, then prove this OpenClaw client against a live ambiguous-slug response.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main ownership history could not be retrieved in the read-only sandbox, so no evidence-backed individual owner can be selected.
